name: Discover it Cash Back

intro_offer.headline: Discover matches all cash back earned in your first year
intro_offer.spend_requirement: automatically, at the end of your first year

rewards.on: everyday purchases at different places each quarter — groceries, restaurants, gas stations, and more — up to $1,500 each quarter when activated

regular_apr: 18.24% to 27.24% variable, depending on your credit
intro_apr: 0% for 15 months on purchases and balance transfers
rating_reason: The first-year match is excellent value if you spend in the rotating categories. The 5% cap at $1,500 per quarter limits upside for heavy spenders, and you must activate each quarter.
best_for: first credit card for someone building credit
people who can stay on top of quarterly activations
skip_if: you do not want to track quarterly categories or activate bonuses each quarter

offer_history.headline: Cash back match at end of first year
